description: This file contains helper functions and tests for verifying bitmap functionality in a Git repository, including setup of complex histories, testing rev-list commands with bitmaps, and managing multi-pack index files with bitmap data.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Normalizes and compares bitmap traversal output files for consistency.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Sets up a complex repository history with merges and branches to test bitmap traversal.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Runs various rev-list commands with bitmap options on a specified branch.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Runs a suite of rev-list tests on predefined branches.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Conducts core tests for rev-list with bitmap features, including cloning and partial clones.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks whether one object is a delta basis of another.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Determines the pack source of a given object via the read-midx tool.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Verifies existence of reverse index for a given commit and kind.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Performs core operations to create and verify multi-pack index with bitmap support.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Sets up partial bitmap tests with complex histories.
